response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience with C++ or Rust in geospatial routing pipelines, despite claiming C++ exposure in academic/thesis work; their professional work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no evidence of distributed systems, routing tile optimization, or navigation data pipelines critical to the role.
strengths: Strong open-source contributions in geospatial tools (GISCollective)
Demonstrated full-stack adaptability across languages and domains
Proven experience with Linux, Docker, and scalable infrastructure
concerns: No commercial C++ or Rust experience in routing or geospatial data pipelines
Lacks demonstrated expertise in fault tolerance, consistency, or navigation systems
Primary tech stack (TypeScript/Node.js) does not align with C++-centric role requirements
